events.title: Burn Out Demo Release NOW!
events.summary: Hello everyone !We hope you’re all doing well.First of all, we’d like to sincerely thank you for your patience and continued support throughout the development of BURN OUT. events.title: Little Sneak Peek Of Burn Out
events.summary: Hello everyone !We hope you’re all doing well.First of all, we’d like to sincerely apologize for the wait and for the lack of communication regarding the game’s development. We know it’s been a while since we’ve shared any updates, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. To make it up to you, we’ve put together a trailer to give you a first glimpse of BURN OUT and what we’ve been working on.We’re also currently working on a demo, which should be released very soon !Stay tuned for more

events.title: Thanks for participating to the playtest!
events.summary: AnnouncementThank you all for participating in the playtest.In our ongoing pursuit of excellence (and after a few deep conversations with our code), we’ve decided to temporarily close registrations in order to carry out a technical overhaul of the game.Our ambition for Burn Out remains unchanged: to deliver a truly solid experience.
